result.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
result.summary: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to support physically grounded self-improvement in video generation models. The harness guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction, distilling their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos. The framework supports controllable training-data construction and inference-time video repair. By identifying and correcting failures, PhysLoop marks a key milestone toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video generation models with limited human intervention. We release 100K videos spanning diverse, realistic indoor and outdoor scenes, along with generation tools and two evaluation datasets: PhysLoop-Gen and PhysLoop-Repair. We evaluate controllable generation and localized repair on these datasets, respectively, and assess physical behavior on the external Physics-IQ Verified benchmark.

AI.brief_summary: PhysLoop 构建了一套围绕视频生成模型的「引导—选择—修正」闭环框架，把 LLM 的物理常识用于构造可控训练数据与推理期视频修复，并发布 100K 视频及两个评测数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作的核心目标是提升生成视频的物理与因果一致性，改进对象是像素级视频输出而非内部推理状态，也未涉及 latent 表示、视觉证据获取或停止决策机制，与 LVR 关注点缺少实质联系。
